name: Skykin
description: Skykin are descended from air elementals. They are humanoids whose bodies are a combination of flesh and air.

features.name: Gale Force
features.description: Mark a Stress to conjure a gust of wind that carries you or an ally up to Very Far range. Additionally, you can always control the speed at which you fall.

features.name: Eye of the Storm
features.description: Spend 2 Hope to grant a +1 bonus to either your or an ally's Evasion until you next take Severe damage or you use Eye of the Storm again.
